summary.zh: 一般将来时用于表达未来会发生的动作、状态、预测、决定、承诺、计划或安排。英语中最常见的形式是“will + 动词原形”和“be going to + 动词原形”。在PTE Academic和IELTS中，一般将来时常用于描述趋势预测、学习计划、研究影响、个人观点、解决方案和未来结果。中国学习者需要特别注意：will后面必须接动词原形，不能加to；be going to中的be动词要根据主语变化；时间状语从句中通常不用will，而用一般现在时表示将来。

structure.formula: Subject + will + base verb / Subject + am/is/are going to + base verb
structure.explanation: 一般将来时主要有两种核心结构。第一种是“will + 动词原形”，常用于临时决定、预测、承诺、意愿或正式表达。第二种是“be going to + 动词原形”，常用于已有计划、明显迹象导致的预测或较确定的安排。否定形式分别是“will not / won’t + 动词原形”和“am/is/are not going to + 动词原形”。疑问句中，will或be动词提前。需要注意，will后面不能使用动词不定式to，也不能使用过去式或第三人称单数形式。

examples.en: The government will introduce new policies to reduce air pollution.
examples.zh: 政府将推出新政策来减少空气污染。

examples.en: I am going to review my notes before the PTE speaking test.
examples.zh: 我打算在PTE口语考试前复习笔记。

examples.en: This trend will have a significant impact on young consumers.
examples.zh: 这一趋势将对年轻消费者产生重大影响。

usage_scenarios.title: 表达未来预测
usage_scenarios.description: 当说话者根据个人判断、数据、趋势或常识预测未来时，可以使用“will + 动词原形”。在学术写作和PTE口语中，这种用法常用于讨论社会、科技、教育、环境等话题的未来影响。

examples.en: Online education will become more common in the next decade.
examples.zh: 在线教育将在未来十年变得更加普遍。

examples.en: The demand for renewable energy will continue to rise.
examples.zh: 可再生能源的需求将继续上升。

usage_scenarios.title: 表达已经计划好的事情
usage_scenarios.description: 当未来行为已经经过计划、安排或决定时，常使用“be going to + 动词原形”。这种结构比will更强调事先准备或明确意图。

examples.en: She is going to take the IELTS test next month.
examples.zh: 她打算下个月参加IELTS考试。

examples.en: We are going to conduct a survey on student satisfaction.
examples.zh: 我们打算开展一项关于学生满意度的调查。

usage_scenarios.title: 表达临时决定
usage_scenarios.description: 当说话者在说话当下才做出决定时，通常使用will，而不是be going to。这一点在口语交流、PTE Repeat Sentence和Answer Short Question中尤其重要。

examples.en: I forgot to send the email. I will do it now.
examples.zh: 我忘记发邮件了。我现在就发。

examples.en: The printer is not working. I will ask the technician for help.
examples.zh: 打印机坏了。我会请技术人员帮忙。

usage_scenarios.title: 表达承诺、主动帮助或意愿
usage_scenarios.description: will可以表示说话者愿意做某事、承诺完成某事，或主动提出帮助。在正式和半正式场景中，will比中文的“会”更具有承诺意味。

examples.en: I will submit the report before the deadline.
examples.zh: 我会在截止日期前提交报告。

examples.en: We will provide further evidence to support this argument.
examples.zh: 我们将提供进一步证据来支持这一论点。

usage_scenarios.title: 表示有明显迹象的未来结果
usage_scenarios.description: 当现在的证据清楚显示某事即将发生时，通常使用be going to。它强调未来结果与当前迹象之间的联系。

examples.en: Look at the dark clouds. It is going to rain.
examples.zh: 看那些乌云。天要下雨了。

examples.en: The company has lost many customers, so it is going to face serious financial problems.
examples.zh: 这家公司已经失去了许多客户，因此它将面临严重的财务问题。

common_mistakes.wrong: He will goes to university next year.
common_mistakes.correct: He will go to university next year.
common_mistakes.explanation: will后面必须接动词原形，不能使用第三人称单数形式goes。这是中国学习者常见错误，因为容易把一般现在时的主谓一致规则错误地套用到一般将来时中。

common_mistakes.wrong: I will to study abroad after graduation.
common_mistakes.correct: I will study abroad after graduation.
common_mistakes.explanation: will是情态助动词，后面直接接动词原形，不需要to。“will to do”不是一般将来时的正确结构。

common_mistakes.wrong: She going to apply for a scholarship.
common_mistakes.correct: She is going to apply for a scholarship.
common_mistakes.explanation: be going to结构中不能省略be动词。主语是she时，be动词应使用is。

common_mistakes.wrong: If it will rain tomorrow, the event will be cancelled.
common_mistakes.correct: If it rains tomorrow, the event will be cancelled.
common_mistakes.explanation: 在if引导的条件状语从句中，通常用一般现在时表示将来，而主句使用will。这类句型在IELTS写作和PTE Writing中非常常见。

common_mistakes.wrong: I am going to will finish the essay tonight.
common_mistakes.correct: I am going to finish the essay tonight.
common_mistakes.explanation: be going to和will不能同时放在同一个谓语动词前表达一个将来动作。应根据语义选择其中一种结构。

common_mistakes.wrong: The number of international students will increases.
common_mistakes.correct: The number of international students will increase.
common_mistakes.explanation: will后面使用动词原形increase，不能加-s。学术写作中描述图表趋势时尤其需要避免该错误。

pte_usage.description: 一般将来时在PTE Academic中使用频率较高，尤其出现在Describe Image、Retell Lecture、Summarize Written Text、Write Essay和口语回答中。考生常需要预测趋势、说明未来影响、提出解决方案或描述计划。正确使用will和be going to可以提高语法准确性和表达自然度。在PTE评分中，时态错误会影响grammar和oral fluency，尤其当考生在描述未来趋势时误用一般现在时或错误使用will后面的动词形式。
sections: Reading & Writing: Fill in the Blanks

academic_patterns.pattern: It is likely that + subject + will + base verb
This trend will lead to + noun phrase
The data suggest that + subject + will + base verb
In the coming years, + subject + will + base verb
If this problem continues, + subject + will + base verb
academic_patterns.translation: 如果这个问题持续下去，……将会……

academic_patterns.pattern: This policy is going to have a long-term impact on + noun
academic_patterns.translation: 这项政策将对……产生长期影响

academic_patterns.pattern: The findings will contribute to a better understanding of + noun
academic_patterns.translation: 这些发现将有助于更好地理解……

academic_patterns.pattern: Future research will focus on + noun / gerund

collocations.phrase: will have a major impact on
will play an important role in
is going to cause serious problems
are going to implement new measures

ai_tips: 在PTE Describe Image中，如果图表包含未来年份，如2030或2050，优先考虑使用will来描述预测趋势，例如“The population will increase steadily.”
写IELTS Task 2结论时，可以用will表达未来结果，但不要过度重复“I think it will”。可替换为“This approach will help...”或“These measures will reduce...”。
看到if、when、after、before、unless引导的时间或条件状语从句时，通常从句用一般现在时，主句用will，例如“When technology improves, education will become more accessible.”
如果是已经安排好的个人计划，be going to通常比will更自然，例如“I am going to take the PTE test next Friday.”
检查句子时重点看will后面的动词：必须是动词原形，不能加-s、-ed、to或-ing。

practice_questions.question: 用正确形式完成句子：The demand for electric cars ______ (increase) in the next few years.
改正错误：She will to attend the academic conference next week.
practice_questions.answer: She will attend the academic conference next week.

practice_questions.question: 选择正确答案：Look at the sky. It ______ rain soon. A. will B. is going to
用英文翻译：如果政府采取有效措施，空气质量将会改善。
practice_questions.answer: If the government takes effective measures, air quality will improve.

practice_questions.question: 改正错误：If the population will grow rapidly, cities will face more pressure.
practice_questions.answer: If the population grows rapidly, cities will face more pressure.

practice_questions.question: 用一般将来时完成句子：Future research ______ (focus) on the relationship between sleep and memory.
practice_questions.answer: Future research will focus on the relationship between sleep and memory.

practice_questions.question: 选择更合适的表达：我已经决定今晚复习PTE词汇。A. I will review PTE vocabulary tonight. B. I am going to review PTE vocabulary tonight.
practice_questions.answer: B. I am going to review PTE vocabulary tonight.

practice_questions.question: 改写为否定句：The policy will solve the problem immediately.
practice_questions.answer: The policy will not solve the problem immediately. / The policy won’t solve the problem immediately.
